diagnosis: Successfully implemented P2P via GDRCopy BAR1 staging ring + D2D copy. NVMe DMAs directly into GPU BAR1 memory, then a device-to-device cudaMemcpyAsync moves data to final destination. Achieved 3.97 GB/s / 1.11ms p99 (72% over baseline). Iteratively optimized: removed DRAM backfill, lazy stream sync, 64 ring slots with thread partitioning, reduced lock contention.
